entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Karen. How can I help you today?
Hi Karen, I'm calling about an order. I bought the ClubFit Jersey a few weeks ago, and I'd like to return it.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up our policy... Yes, it looks like you have up to 90 days for a return.
Oh, great. So it's okay that I've had it for about three weeks?
Yes, that's absolutely no problem at all. Since you're well within the 90 days, I can go ahead and process that for you. I just need to confirm your email address to send the return label.
Wow, that was easy. My email is example@email.com.

Perfect. I've just sent that return label to your email. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Karen!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
